record.name: Document Receipt
record.summary: Acknowledge receipt of a specified document.
record.overview: A service delivers a document and asks the recipient to acknowledge that they received it.
record.target: The delivered document and its revision.

operations.name: Acknowledge receipt
operations.description: Record receipt of the identified document.

record.inputs: The delivery reference and document revision.
record.results: Receipt recorded, or an explanation of why the acknowledgement was not recorded.
record.permissions: The service checks that the caller may acknowledge receipt for the intended recipient.
record.humanRoute: A document page with the same acknowledgement operation.

example.title: Acknowledge a revised delivery note
steps: The service delivers revision 2 of a delivery note.
The service records receipt of that revision.
example.exception: Receipt does not indicate agreement with the document or approval of a separate operation.

references.description: Candidate vocabulary to assess when describing the acknowledgement operation.
